content.title: Walmart Jumps to Nasdaq in Biggest Exchange Transfer on Record
content.summary: The Bentonville, Arkansas-based company, which has been on the NYSE since 1972, said it expects its shares to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, the highest of the exchange’s three tiers, on Dec. 9.  The move to the tech-heavy Nasdaq reflects Walmart’s “technology-forward approach,” the retailer said, and it will transfer the listing of nine bonds to the exchange as well.  Large companies have made the move before, with PepsiCo Inc. abandoning its nearly century-long listing on the NYSE in 2017.
